concept: Cinematic wide photograph of a long corridor with floor-to-ceiling windows on both sides, each window showing a different landscape: one side shows a city skyline at night with neon, the other shows a mountain range at golden hour. The corridor floor is polished black marble reflecting both views. A single figure walks away from camera down the center of the corridor, dressed in minimal black, backlit by the warm golden light at the end. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, anamorphic 40mm lens, natural light only. The image captures the parallax concept literally: two completely different worlds visible simultaneously from one position. Color grade: cool teal shadows, warm amber highlights, deep blacks. Cinematic 2.39:1 framing within the 16:9 frame. No text.

creative_direction.thesis: A single figure walks through a reflective corridor, simultaneously witnessing and embodying the tension between two impossibly contrasting worlds: a neon city night and a golden hour mountain range.

three_anchors.visual_hook: The impossible juxtaposition of a vibrant cyberpunk city and a serene mountain range, visible through opposing windows in a single, hyper-reflective corridor.
three_anchors.emotional_core: A profound sense of solitude, contemplation, and the expansive, often conflicting, choices or perspectives one faces in life.
three_anchors.cultural_anchor: The visual language of neo-noir cinematography (specifically Blade Runner 2049) combined with a minimalist architectural aesthetic and philosophical themes of duality.

creative_direction.prompt: A lone figure, dressed in minimalist matte black attire, seen from behind, walking slowly away from the camera, perfectly centered in an impossibly long, symmetrical architectural corridor. This corridor features towering floor-to-ceiling, seamless glass windows on both opposing sides. The corridor floor is a perfectly polished black obsidian marble, creating flawless mirror reflections of both landscapes above. The far end of the corridor recedes into a bright, diffuse warm light. The left window reveals a sprawling, hyper-detailed cyberpunk metropolis skyline at deep night, teeming with vibrant, saturated neon signs, holographic advertisements, and electric city lights (predominantly electric blues, glowing purples, fiery reds). The right window reveals a majestic, rugged mountain range under a low, soft golden hour sun, casting dramatic long shadows and bathed in rich earth tones (deep oranges, warm yellows, muted browns, hints of sage green). The figure is strongly silhouetted by a warm, diffuse golden backlight emanating from the far end of the corridor. The left window projects cool, electric artificial light into the corridor's left side, while the right window filters in soft, warm golden light onto the corridor's right side. The polished black marble floor perfectly reflects both the distinct lighting conditions and the contrasting landscapes, creating a seamless blend of cool and warm light on its surface. Ultra-wide cinematic shot, captured on ARRI Alexa 65, anamorphic 40mm lens, low angle, extreme depth of field, cinematic 2.39:1 aspect ratio letterboxed within a 16:9 frame. Cool teal (#008080) dominating shadows and city reflection, warm amber (#FFBF00) for highlights and mountain reflection, deep obsidian blacks (#000000) for the floor and figure's silhouette. Surreal, contemplative, solitary, expansive, philosophical, duality, neo-noir tension, profound quiet. Cinematography inspired by Roger Deakins' work in Blade Runner 2049, architectural scale of Syd Mead, minimalist aesthetic, conceptual art.
creative_direction.negative_elements: Text, logos, blurry details, distorted reflections, inconsistent lighting, multiple figures, busy background within the corridor, anything that breaks the surreal and minimalist tension.
creative_direction.art_direction_notes: The core concept of parallax is literalized through the opposing windows and their reflections, creating a visually striking and thought-provoking image. The careful balance of opposing color temperatures (cool teal vs. warm amber) enhances the duality. The ARRI Alexa 65 and anamorphic lens ensure a high-fidelity cinematic feel, while the minimalist figure emphasizes the vastness of the setting and the internal journey. The letterboxing maintains a true cinematic aspect ratio within the 16:9 frame, reinforcing the filmic quality.
